data.one_liner: A pure Dart tus client for resumable file uploads.
data.what_it_does: Allows pausing, canceling, and resuming file uploads using the tus protocol over HTTP. It supports both file-based and stream-based uploads with configurable chunk sizes, persistent caching, and progress tracking.
use_when: You need resumable file uploads that can survive app restarts, crashes, or network drops.
You are uploading large files where chunking and progress reporting are required.
avoid_when: Your backend does not support the tus protocol.
You only need simple, non-resumable HTTP file uploads.
strengths: Supports persistent caching to automatically resume uploads after app restarts.
Pure Dart implementation with broad platform support including mobile, desktop, and web.
weaknesses: Requires a server that specifically implements the tus protocol.
Default fingerprint generation can break if the creation URL is one-time or pre-signed without custom overrides.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you do not need the tus protocol and just want to perform standard HTTP requests.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust general-purpose HTTP client with interceptors and FormData support rather than a dedicated tus protocol client.
